links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic rank, confidence and time to diagnosis with versus without AI in randomized crossover
links.effect: FusionRare elevated true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improved physician confidence in 62%, and reduced time to diagnosis by 21%.
links.quote: A randomized, crossover clinician-AI validation demonstrated that FusionRare elevates the true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improves physician confidence in 62%, and reduces time to diagnosis by 21%.

unlisted_practices: Fusing symbolic, deep-learning, case-retrieval and LLM paradigms via meta-aggregation and agentic reflection for rare disease diagnosis

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-paradigm agentic/LLM diagnostic framework via benchmarks and a randomized crossover clinician-AI user study assessing decision impact, diagnostic rank, physician confidence, and time to diagnosis.
